# Sheetal Sonic - Ultrasonic Welding Parts

> Leading supplier of Branson, Herrmann, and Telsonic ultrasonic welding machines, converters, boosters, and replacement parts for industrial welding applications.

Sheetal Sonic (operated by Sheetal Enterprises) specializes in ultrasonic welding equipment and spare parts across multiple frequencies (20kHz, 35kHz, 40kHz). The company offers both new and used welding machines, converters, boosters, and accessories from major manufacturers including Branson, Herrmann, Telsonic, and Bensonic.

## Key Topics

- Branson ultrasonic welders
- Converters and boosters
- 20kHz frequency
- 40kHz frequency
- 35kHz frequency
- Replacement parts
- Telsonic welding equipment
- Herrmann converters
- Titanium boosters
- Industrial welding technology
- Transistors and stepper drives
- Branson 803 Converter
- Telsonic SE3512
- Branson CR20 Converter
- Welding horns and sensors

## Branson Ultrasonic Equipment

- [Branson Ultrasonic Welders](https://www.ultrasonicweldingparts.com/collections/branson-ultrasonic-welders): Used Branson ultrasonic welding machines including 8400, 8600, 8700, 8800 series
- [Branson Converter](https://www.ultrasonicweldingparts.com/collections/branson-converter): Branson converter product collection including CR20, 902J, and 803 models
- [Branson Boosters](https://www.ultrasonicweldingparts.com/collections/branson-boosters): Branson booster amplifiers at 20kHz and 40kHz frequencies with various ratios
- [Branson Accessories](https://www.ultrasonicweldingparts.com/collections/branson-accessories): Branson replacement parts including horns, transistors, and sensors

## Converter & Booster Solutions

- [Herrmann Converter](https://www.ultrasonicweldingparts.com/collections/herrmann-converter): Herrmann converter models A-KHS20-S, HS-HM35, and CCS G3 20/S series
- [Telsonic Converter](https://www.ultrasonicweldingparts.com/collections/telsonic-converter-1): Telsonic converter models SE3512, SE-2050A, and SE2030A for ultrasonic welding
